Sound law is inanimate but Buddha is sentient. Buddhas and Bodhisattvas of great compassion, tirelessly and persistently turning the wheel of Dharma, depending on the opportunity to teach, depending on the opportunity to reveal, to benefit all sentient beings, only then can sentient beings have a place to follow to escape suffering and be happy, which is the ultimate path of liberation, quickly becoming a bright light on the other shore.
